mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_report_access (open_id, report_type, report_id, grant_source, granted_at, deleted) VALUES (#{openId}, #{reportType}, #{reportId}, #{grantSource}, #{grantedAt}, 0)

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_report_access (open_id, report_type, report_id, grant_source, granted_at, deleted) SELECT s.open_id, 1, r.id, 1, NOW(), 0 FROM t_report r INNER JOIN t_answer_session s ON s.id = r.answer_session_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE s.open_id = #{openId} AND r.deleted = 0
